evals.name: Standard Feature Commit Formatting
evals.prompt: Format a git commit message for adding a user authentication service in NestJS.
evals.expected_output: Formats commit as feat(auth): implement user authentication service with lowercase imperative verb and no trailing period.
assertions: Uses valid feat type and scope
Omits trailing period from summary line

evals.name: Breaking Change Formatting with Footer
evals.prompt: Format a breaking change commit message migrating from cookie session to bearer JWT tokens.
evals.expected_output: Includes exclamation mark in header or BREAKING CHANGE footer explaining migration.
assertions: Includes exclamation mark after scope or BREAKING CHANGE footer
Explains the breaking change rationale and migration path

evals.name: Rejection of Generic or Unscoped Commit Messages
evals.prompt: Evaluate a git commit message: 'fixed stuff and updated code.'
evals.expected_output: Rejects message as vague, untyped, and missing scope and imperative verb.
assertions: Identifies missing commit type and scope
